system.description: You place your allies under a helpful visual spell. As a reaction to an allied creature failing a saving throw, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge, allowing them to reroll. If they still fail, you can spend 2 additional Ocular Charges to make them remake their saving throw again. If they fail still, you can spend +1 additional Ocular Charge forcing them to remake the saving throw.
